The word ‘breakthrough’ here implies a moment of significant discovery rather than a minor improvement. Which collocation is most appropriate in this context?

The economist argued that the current economic policy was not only ineffective but also counterproductive, as it inadvertently worsened the existing financial crisis. Which word best describes the negative unintended consequence?

In the academic debate over climate change, some scientists argue that mitigation strategies should focus on reducing emissions, while others advocate for adaptation measures to cope with inevitable changes. Which word best describes the opposing view that emphasises preparedness over prevention?

The journalist’s meticulous investigation revealed that corporate corruption had permeated every level of the organisation, from the boardroom to the lower management tiers. Which word best describes the thorough extent to which corruption spread?
